Date: 2027-04-18T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: SIG questionnaire initiation - Acme Health

Hi Priya / procurement team,

Thanks again for taking time to speak with us earlier today — great conversation and appreciate the clarity on your security bar. Quick recap and next steps from my side: 

- Scope: Acme Health is evaluating Redwood for patient-facing features. You flagged HIPAA and SOC 2 controls as primary requirements.
- What I heard: you need a completed vendor security questionnaire (SIG/standard), confirmation of SOC 2 status and audit timing, and clarity on data residency and BAAs.

We generally handle that by:
- Initiating the SIG questionnaire (attached: Redwood_SIG_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx) and sharing a drive link for collaborative review.
- Marissa (cc'd) will own most of the technical/control-level responses (SOC 2, controls mapping, encryption, KMS/HSM).
- Logan (cc'd) can help with architecture specifics for Private deployment and HIPAA-related configurations.

Clarifying questions for you so we can scope the SIG appropriately:
1) Should we complete only the production-scope questions, or include non-prod environment controls as well?
2) Do you need a fully self-hosted (air-gapped) option documented, or is a VPC + BAA sufficient for your legal/compliance team?
3) Target date: is April 26 reasonable for returning a draft? If you need it sooner, let me know and we can prioritize.

Next steps: I'll upload our SIG template and Marissa will begin the control answers. We'll flag any items that require legal sign-off (e.g., BAA).

Attachments: Redwood_SIG_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to getting this over the line.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmehealth.com>

Cc: Acme Health Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T14:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation - Acme Health

Thanks Camila — appreciate the quick follow-up and the attachment. A few clarifying questions from our side before you complete the SIG: 

1) SOC 2: is Redwood already SOC 2 Type II certified? If not, what is the current status and expected report date? We need to know the audit period/effective date.
2) HIPAA: does Redwood sign a BAA for hosted customers, or is HIPAA compliance only via Private deployments (VPC/on-prem)? If you do sign BAAs for hosted, any specifics we should expect (data handling, logging, access controls)?
3) Data residency: can you confirm where production data is stored for hosted customers (AWS regions)? We may require US-only residency for PHI.
4) Encryption & KMS: do you offer customer-managed keys (BYOK/HSM) for encryption at rest or only service-managed keys?

If helpful, I'm attaching our procurement questionnaire template for context (Acme_Security_Questionnaire_v1.docx). Target for us is to have a draft back by the end of next week (week of 4/26).

Thanks — Priya
Priya Shah
Director, Information Security | Acme Health
priya.shah@acmehealth.com | (212) 555-0192

Attachment: Acme_Security_Questionnaire_v1.docx
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Acme Health Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation - Acme Health

Thanks Priya — great questions. Answers below at a high level; Marissa will follow up with control-level detail in the completed SIG.

- SOC 2: Redwood is currently in the final stages of our SOC 2 Type II audit for the period Jan 1, 2026 — Dec 31, 2026. We expect the final report to be issued in Q3 2027. We can provide our SOC 2 Type I report and interim evidence now and will share the Type II report as soon as it's available.

- HIPAA / BAA: We do offer BAAs. For customers handling PHI on our hosted product we typically require Private deployment (VPC) for production PHI, but we will execute a BAA for hosted customers in some enterprise agreements with additional controls and logging enabled. Marissa can detail the exact contractual language and required configurations.

- Data residency: For hosted customers, production data is stored in AWS; we can provision US-only regions (us-east-1 or us-west-2) to satisfy US residency requirements. Private deployments can be run on-prem or in a customer VPC to meet stricter residency rules.

- Encryption & KMS: We support service-managed keys by default and customer-managed keys (BYOK) for Dedicated and Private deployment customers. HSM integrations are supported for Private deployments.

Proposed next step: Marissa will start filling the SIG spreadsheet. Can you confirm whether we should answer the non-prod environment questions as well, or limit to production controls?

We're aiming to return a draft by Monday, April 26 — is that still acceptable?

Best,
Camila

Hi all — thanks Priya and Camila. I've started populating the SIG answers and attached a draft spreadsheet (SIG_answers_draft.xlsx). Notes and outstanding clarifications: 

- SOC 2: I'll include our SOC 2 Type I and share interim evidence (system descriptions, control owners). For Type II, I'll note expected Q3 delivery and provide the audit firm name.
- HIPAA / BAA: We will provide standard BAA language. For hosted PHI, we recommend Private deployment; however, we will list the hosted controls and logging available for an enterprise-hosted BAA.
- Encryption/KMS: Draft answer states we support service-managed KMS in hosted and BYOK for Dedicated/Private. Marcus — can you confirm whether HSM-backed BYOK is available in the current Private package or if that's an add-on?
- Data residency: I'll indicate US-only region options and note which regions we can guarantee for production (us-east-1, us-west-2).

Action items:
- Marcus to confirm HSM/BYOK availability (cc'd).
- Logan to add a short architecture diagram link for Private deployment (I put a placeholder in the spreadsheet).
- Camila to confirm target date with Priya (Camila: Priya indicated week of 4/26).

Attachment: SIG_answers_draft.xlsx

I'll update the draft today and share a link in Drive for review. If you need this sooner than 4/26, we can prioritize the high-risk control sets first.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
